# Submission
*Thanks for submitting to the mini workshop on Age Assurance. Please respond to any or all of the questions below in less than 500 words each.*
## Title

## What are your biggest concerns about the technical solutions currently being deployed for age assurance?

## Where are the opportunities for genuinely improving online safety? Our primary focus is on technical solutions but you may also have suggestions about how to help effective solutions to gain traction in the real world.

## What useful work could W3C be incubating for age assurance? How can web standards help to mitigate negative impacts or increase adoption of positive approaches?
